injuries.shortComment: Nolen (calf) is questionable against the Lions on Sunday, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Nolen was limited by a calf injury in each of the last two practices of Week 5 prep. If he's inactive for Sunday's game, then Andrew Billings and L.J. Collier would both be in line for more defensive snaps alongside fellow DT Roy Lopez.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor-Demerson (back) does not have an injury designation against the Lions on Sunday, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Taylor-Demerson was a full participant in Friday's practice, which was enough for him to fade an injury tag for Sunday's home contest. He missed the Cardinals' previous two games due to a back injury, and he could start next to Budda Baker at safety due to the absence of Andrew Wingard (knee).

injuries.shortComment: Wingard (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Wingard was held out of practice all week due to a bone bruise in his knee, which he sustained against the Giants in Week 4. Wydett Williams figures to start alongside Budda Baker at safety due to the absence of Wingard, whose next chance to play is Week 6 against the Rams on Sunday, Oct. 18.

injuries.shortComment: Love (ankle) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest versus the Lions, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.
injuries.longComment: Love emerged from Week 4 action with an ankle injury that limited him at practice Wednesday and Thursday, but he didn't have any restrictions at Friday's session before getting the all clear for Week 5. He touched on his health afterward, telling Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com that he's feeling "really, really good this week" and that he "found a way I really want to do things just consulting with the training staff and throughout my outside stuff." On Sunday, Love will look to build upon the 259 yards from scrimmage and two total TDs on 66 touches that he's racked up through the first four games of his career.

injuries.shortComment: Matthews (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
injuries.longComment: Matthews was able to log a full practice Friday, but the Falcons aren't quite ready to clear the veteran offensive lineman for Sunday's game. If he cannot play due to a groin injury, then Michael Jerrell would likely start at left tackle.

injuries.shortComment: Abdullah (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Abdullah was held out of practice all week due to a hamstring injury and will not suit up Sunday, leaving Cameron Thomas and Jared Ivey as the top rotational options on the edge. Abdullah's next chance to play is Week 6 against the Bears on Sunday, Oct. 18.

injuries.shortComment: Smith (concussion/neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site  reports.
injuries.longComment: Smith was a limited participant in Friday's practice as he continues to deal with a concussion he suffered in the Falcons' win over the Saints on Monday. The linebacker still needs to be cleared for full contact by an independent neurologist. If the 34-year-old still has concussion symptoms Saturday, he will not be able to suit up for Sunday's game.

injuries.shortComment: Deablo (hamstring) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Ravens, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site  reports.
injuries.longComment: Deablo was a limited participant in Friday's practice with a hamstring injury. The linebacker played through the injury during the Falcons' blowout win over the Saints on Monday Night Football. Diablo played 81 percent of the Falcons' defensive snaps in the contest and will likely suit up for a similar snap share in Sunday's game against the Ravens.
